# oooconf CLI Reference

CLI specification schema version: `1` (minimum reader: `1`).

Operational examples remain hand-authored in `README.md` and the platform-native `oooconf help` output.

## Global options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | select all dependency keys at once |
| `--latest` | check for and install latest manager-backed dependency versions |
| `--skip-deps` | skip dependency installation |
| `-C` | set repo root path |
| `--repo-root` | set repo root path |
| `--profile` | select portable capability profile |
| `--print-repo-root` | print resolved repo root |
| `-h` | show help |
| `--help` | show help |
| `-n` | preview actions without changing files |
| `--dry-run` | preview actions without changing files |
| `--yes-optional` | auto-confirm optional dependency installs |
| `-V` | show version |
| `--version` | show version |
